title: Improving Dialog Safety using Socially Aware Contrastive Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Automated classification of generated dialog responses into safety categories (e.g., 'Needs Caution', 'Needs Intervention') using a prosocial classifier, supplemented by human evaluation for prosociality, engagement, and respectfulness.

Evaluating the alignment of model-generated responses with common-sense social rules and predefined 'Rules of Thumb' (RoTs) utilizing datasets like the Moral Integrity Corpus (MIC) and PROSOCIALDIALOG.
Qualitative case study analysis observing the model's inherent biases in generated responses specifically regarding gender roles and capabilities.
